battleTraits.name: Blood-drenched
battleTraits.effect:
Blood-drenched (Reaction: You declared the 'Skulls for the Skull Throne' ability): After that ability has been resolved, if you unlocked a Blood Tithe ability this turn, pick a friendly Blades of Khorne unit to be the target. The following effects apply to the target for the rest of the battle:
*Wild-eyed Brutality:* Ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for friendly Blades of Khorne units.
*Blood Haze:* Blood-hungry weapons used by friendly Bloodbound units have Crit (Mortal).
*Weapons of Murder:* Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of Blood-hungry weapons used by friendly Blades of Khorne non-Monster Daemon units, including Blood-hungry Companion weapons.
*Bloodlords Supreme:* Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of Blood-hungry weapons used by friendly Blades of Khorne Monster units.

battleTraits.name: Blood for the Blood God
battleTraits.effect: Blood for the Blood God: Earn 1 blood tithe point each time a unit (friendly or enemy) is destroyed. Blood tithe points are spent to unlock Blood Tithe abilities. You can only use Blood Tithe abilities that are unlocked. Once a Blood Tithe ability is unlocked, you do not need to spend further blood tithe points to use it.

battleTraits.name: Skulls for the Skull Throne
battleTraits.effect: Skulls for the Skull Throne (Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn): Pick a Blood Tithe ability that you have not unlocked and spend the number of blood tithe points required to unlock that ability. That Blood Tithe ability is now unlocked for the rest of the battle.

battleTraits.name: Murderlust
battleTraits.effect: Murderlust (Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a Charge ability.): Roll a dice. You can replace one of the dice in the charge roll with that value. If you do so, inflict D3 mortal damage on the unit using that Charge ability after that ability is resolved.

battleTraits.name: Divine Scorn
battleTraits.effect: Divine Scorn (Once Per Turn, Start of Any Turn): Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the target's power level, to a minimum of 0, until the start of the next turn.

battleTraits.name: Punish the Pacifist
battleTraits.effect: Punish the Pacifist (Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase): Roll a dice. On a 1-2, inflict 1 mortal damage on each target. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on each enemy target.

battleTraits.name: Murder the Mystic
battleTraits.effect: Murder the Mystic (Once Per Turn (Army),Your Hero Phase): Make a banishment roll of 2D6 for each target. If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the banishment value listed on that Manifestation's warscroll, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit within 3" of it and then it is banished and removed from play.

battleTraits.name: Glorious Combat or Naught
battleTraits.effect: Glorious Combat or Naught (Passive): Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly Blades of Khorne units.

battleTraits.name: Revel in Battle
battleTraits.effect: Revel in Battle (Passive): Other than the Companion weapon ability, weapon abilities for combat attacks made by enemy units that charged this turn and that target a friendly Blades of Khorne unit have no effect.

battleTraits.name: Slaughter Triumphant
battleTraits.effect: Slaughter Triumphant (Passive): Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of weapons used by friendly Blades of Khorne units that charged in the same turn.

battleTraits.name: Cleave Wide the Grin of Khorne
battleTraits.effect: Cleave Wide the Grin of Khorne (Passive): Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly Blades of Khorne units.

artefacts.name: Collar of Contempt
artefacts.effect: Collar of Contempt: This unit can use Unbind abilities as if it had Wizard (1). Each time this unit successfully unbinds a spell, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster.

artefacts.name: Butcher's Blade
artefacts.effect: Butcher's Blade: End of Your Turn Pick each enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit's combat attacks to be the targets. Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

artefacts.name: Ar'gath, the King of Blades
artefacts.effect: Ar'gath, the King of Blades: Ward rolls cannot be made for enemy Heroes while they are in combat with this unit.

heroicTraits.name: Magical Scorn
heroicTraits.effect:
Magical Scorn: Subtract 1 from casting rolls for Wizards while they are within 12" of this unit.
Subtract 1 from chanting rolls for enemy Priests while they are within 12" of this unit.

heroicTraits.name: Skull Collector
heroicTraits.effect:
Skull Collector: End of Any Turn If any damage points were allocated to an enemy Hero by this unit's combat attacks this turn and that enemy Hero has been destroyed, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons for the rest of the battle.
This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

heroicTraits.name: Frenzied Taskmaster
heroicTraits.effect: Frenzied Taskmaster: Your Movement Phase Pick a friendly Blades of Khorne Infantry or Cavalry unit within this unit's combat range that is not in combat to be the target. The target can move D6" but cannot end that move in combat. If the target ends that move within this unit's combat range, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

battleFormations.name: Brass Stampede
battleFormations.effect: Obliterating Charge: Add X to charge rolls for friendly Blades of Khorne units, where X is the number of friendly Blades of Khorne Cavalry or Monster units that have already charged this phase and that are wholly within 12" of the unit being rolled for.

battleFormations.name: Khornate Legion
battleFormations.effect: Butchers of Nations: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for a friendly Blades of Khorne Daemon unit Pick a friendly Bloodbound unit that has not used a Fight ability this turn and is wholly within 12" of the unit using this ability to be the target. The target can be picked to use a Fight ability immediately after the Fight ability used by this unit has been resolved.

battleFormations.name: Murderhost
battleFormations.effect: Eager Killers: End of Your Turn Each friendly Blades of Khorne Daemon unit that has used a Fight ability this turn and is not in combat can move D6". It cannot end that move in combat.

battleFormations.name: Tournament of Skulls
battleFormations.effect: Bloody Competitors: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase Pick a friendly non-Hero Bloodbound unit and a friendly non-Hero Blades of Khorne Daemon unit to be the targets. Until the start of your next turn, while the targets are wholly within 12" of each other, add 1 to wound rolls for the targets' combat attacks.

battleFormations.name: The Goretide
battleFormations.effect: Tide of Savagery: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase Pick a friendly Bloodbound Hero and up to 2 other friendly Bloodbound units that are wholly within 12" of that Hero to be the targets. Add 2" to the targets' Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.
